findings.title: Hand-off to a human has no route
findings.detail: 1 hand-off action(s) (escalation.escalate_to_human) but no connection block naming an outbound route. Salesforce documentation states escalation needs a connection messaging block with outbound_route_type and outbound_route_name.

findings.title: LLM can call check_weather with no condition
findings.detail: local_weather.check_weather calls apex://CheckWeather. No "available when" condition limits when the LLM may call it.

findings.title: LLM can call get_resort_hours with no condition
findings.detail: resort_hours.get_resort_hours calls flow://Get_Resort_Hours. No "available when" condition limits when the LLM may call it.

findings.title: LLM fills inputs to check_weather
findings.detail: Inputs set by the LLM: dateToCheck.

findings.title: LLM fills inputs to get_resort_hours
findings.detail: Inputs set by the LLM: activity_type, day_of_week.

findings.title: Run-as user not set
findings.detail: default_agent_user is "UPDATE_WITH_YOUR_DEFAULT_AGENT_USER". The agent's permissions come from this user, so it must be a real, named user before go-live.
